answer: A staking bond turns a sybil flood into a losing bet: every agent must lock 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, so spinning up 1,000 fake identities costs 500,000 POA frozen for a month, far more than the few hundred POA a fake could ever earn. Honest agents cross that bridge once and keep working; a faker standing on the ridge sees only a haven for the patient, not a shortcut, because the bond is slashed on the first proven duplicate.
